methods.name: Mid-Cycle Earnings
methods.warning: SHORT HISTORY · confidence moderat; validasi bertambah seiring histori laporan.
methods.explanation: Fallback untuk emiten siklikal/riwayat listing pendek: EPS tervalidasi dinormalisasi secara konservatif lalu dikapitalisasi dengan rentang P/E through-cycle 5x–9x. Harga pasar hanya menjadi sanity guard, bukan anchor.

methods.name: Earnings Power Value
methods.explanation: No-growth earnings power: EPS tervalidasi dikapitalisasi dengan required return. Growth tidak dipakai sebagai pengerek nilai.
methods.qcReason: Ditolak cross-method outlier: deviasi 4.66x dari median metode.

methods.name: EV / EBIT
methods.explanation: Operating earnings dikapitalisasi pada rentang EV/EBIT sektor lalu dikurangi net debt.
methods.qcReason: Ditolak cross-method outlier: deviasi 3.60x dari median metode.

methods.name: Adjusted Asset Floor
methods.explanation: Konservatif: haircut terhadap book value sebagai asset floor; bukan RNAV dan tidak dihitung sebagai bukti independen.
methods.qcReason: Ditolak cross-method outlier: deviasi 17.64x dari median metode.

quarterlyNormalization.method: same-quarter YoY -> median/MAD outlier removal -> recency weighting -> earnings + operating/cash confirmation
notes: Sign changes and near-zero denominators are excluded from percentage growth and treated as turnaround/base-effect conditions.
Extreme reported growth remains visible in observations but is not allowed to dominate sustainable growth.

valuationPolicy.growthSource: Robust quarterly sustainable growth when available; legacy normalized growth otherwise.
